# Arx Clips

> Arx Clips is a private, self-hosted AI video clipper that turns long recordings into captioned vertical clips.

## Canonical resources

- Application: https://clips.arxsable.ai/
- Source: https://github.com/Oscar-G13/arxsable-clips
- Contact: oscar@arxsable.ai

## Capabilities

- Uploaded-video input and private processing.
- AI-assisted clip discovery and candidate scoring.
- Face-aware 9:16 reframing.
- Word-synced captions and editable caption templates.
- Export presets for YouTube Shorts, TikTok, and Instagram Reels.
- Configurable transcription and language-model providers.

## Current qualification

- File uploads are operational.
- YouTube link imports remain unavailable while YouTube blocks the server-side downloader.
- Users should process only videos they own or have permission to repurpose.
- Virality scores prioritize review; they do not guarantee audience performance.

Last reviewed: 2026-10-27
